original_frontmatter.description: Build sheltered waterfronts in Three.js with depth-aware reflections of docks and signs, rain rings, boats that ride the swell, and wakes that follow turns. Use for night harbours, canals, urban quays, or a game boat whose reflection slides away from the hull.
